workflows.name: Old scan
workflows.for: For scanned prints, slides and negatives.
workflows.note: Enlarges and sharpens, and smooths film grain. Does not remove scratches or dust, and does not change colours.
workflows.detail_extra: Black and white? Tick Colour afterwards. The colours are the model's guess.

workflows.name: Low-light phone photo
workflows.for: For phone photos taken indoors or at night that look grainy.
workflows.note: Removes grain at the original size. Very fine texture, such as hair or fabric, can get smoother.

workflows.name: Drawing or anime
workflows.for: For drawings, anime frames, comics and flat artwork.
workflows.note: Keeps lines clean and colours flat. Flattens hatching and print texture: for old comics and prints, choose Best. Not for photos.

workflows.name: Web image (JPEG)
workflows.for: For small, blocky pictures saved from websites or chats.
workflows.note: Removes compression blocks, then enlarges 2×. Detail the compression destroyed does not come back.
